steps.en: Install the library with its default toolbox
Pick any model backend — hosted or local
steps.zh: 挑一个模型后端——托管或本地都行

steps.en: Wrap your tools into a code-acting agent, then run the task
steps.zh: 把工具包进「写代码」的 agent，然后跑任务

steps.en: The model answers with a Python snippet; your tools are just function calls inside it
steps.zh: 模型用一段 Python 代码作答，你的工具就是代码里的普通函数调用

steps.en: Executes the snippet — isolate it with E2B, Modal, Blaxel or Docker for anything untrusted
steps.zh: 执行这段代码——不可信输入须接 E2B/Modal/Docker 沙箱

steps.en: Appends each result to memory and loops until the code calls final_answer
steps.zh: 把每次结果追加回记忆并循环，直到代码调用 final_answer

value.en: A multi-step agent in a few readable lines — no framework worldview attached
value.zh: 几行可读代码就有一个多步 agent——不附带任何框架的世界观

sources: https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents README.md 'Quick demo' (pip install "smolagents[toolkit]"; InferenceClientModel / LiteLLMModel / TransformersModel; agent = CodeAgent(tools=[WebSearchTool()], model=model, stream_outputs=True); agent.run("How many seconds would it take for a leopard at full speed to run through Pont des Arts?"); agent.push_to_hub)

https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents README.md 'How do Code agents work?' (ReAct loop; actions as Python snippets; 'final_answer' tool ends the loop; E2B/Blaxel/Modal/Docker sandboxes; LocalPythonExecutor is not a security boundary; ToolCallingAgent alternative)
https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents README.md 'How smol is this library?' (agents.py <1,000 lines; multi-agent hierarchies)
